children: Subramanian brings experience across strategy, business leadership, transformation and governance, spanning banking, technology, real estate and consulting

Axis Bank has appointed Arvind Subramanian as an Additional Independent Director, bringing a senior business leadership profile with experience across strategy consulting, operating roles, transformation and corporate governance.

The appointment adds a board member with experience across multiple sectors and senior executive roles. Subramanian currently serves as Executive Vice President and Managing Director for India at Iron Mountain, alongside a global mandate for Enterprise Strategy and Incubation.

At Iron Mountain, Subramanian leads the India business and is part of the company’s global executive leadership team. Since January 2026, he has also led Enterprise Strategy and Incubation globally, with responsibilities spanning portfolio strategy, growth platforms, innovation and operating models.

His India mandate includes commercial performance, operations, organisational leadership and growth across the company’s information management, data centre infrastructure and asset lifecycle management businesses.

Before joining Iron Mountain, Subramanian was Managing Director and CEO of Mahindra Lifespaces, where he served from July 2020 to May 2023. He had earlier led Mahindra Happinest as Chief Executive Officer.
He also served as Regional CEO at Lodha Group between 2014 and 2018, adding real estate operating experience to his leadership background.

Subramanian spent nearly 15 years with Boston Consulting Group, where he was Managing Director and Partner. He led the Technology, Media and Telecommunications practice in India and worked across sectors including technology, telecom, industrial goods and consumer products.

Subramanian joined the Axis Bank board as an Independent Director in September 2026. His board experience comes alongside senior executive responsibilities involving strategy, capital allocation, organisational development and business transformation.
His career has included roles requiring oversight of growth strategies, operating performance, leadership teams and stakeholder management across different business environments.

Subramanian holds a B.Tech in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology, Madras, and a postgraduate management qualification from the Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad.
His appointment comes as Axis Bank continues to strengthen its board-level experience across areas including business strategy, leadership and corporate governance.
